card.title: You Saw Me Through
card.instruction: Treat past comfort you received as an enduring bond that should now earn honesty, patience, and reciprocal support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You sat with me when my shop closed. Will you help at the new stall? An honest answer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't know. My own shop's struggling.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then forget the stall. You let me talk for hours when mine went.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could we sit without talking first?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. You gave me three silent evenings. I've kept this one free.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 invokes past support while requesting honest help, A3 reverses the request when B is struggling, and A5 offers the same patient silence once received.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's request for silence to reciprocate the precise form of earlier comfort.
